newsitem.title: UK: NWE GASOLINE BARGES $7 DOWN DESPITE LATE REVIVAL.
newsitem.headline: NWE GASOLINE BARGES $7 DOWN DESPITE LATE REVIVAL.

text.p: NWE gasoline barge values declined by around $7 on Thursday as earlier losses of $9 were partially reversed on reviving futures and on recognition of still tight physical barrels.

The recently active Wall street trader was seen buying at least five Eurograde barges for first half August, with early purchases at $230, $232 and twice at $228 and later deals at $229 and $232, leaving late talk in the $230-$232 FOB ARA range.
The Wall Street trader was also rumoured to have sold a barge - variously described as last decade August and August 7 to end of the month - at $214.
Dealers expected a renewed strengthening in the market as mid-month approaches, arguing many players have been holding back from purchases required for August.
A refiner said the reported westbound trans-Atlantic movement Wednesday of three mogas cargoes had helped to keep the cargo market tight.
Swaps fell by just over $2 for August, while September was quoted $5-$5.50 down.
